name: south-sada-system
description: نظام إدارة شركة صدى الجنوب للمقاولات الإنشائية - نظام محلي متكامل

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && prisma generate && next build
scripts.db:push: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && prisma db push && tsx scripts/enable-rls.ts && tsx scripts/setup-assistant-role.ts
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && prisma db push --force-reset && prisma db seed
scripts.setup: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && prisma db push && tsx scripts/enable-rls.ts && prisma db seed
scripts.cloud:migrate: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && prisma generate && prisma db push --skip-generate && tsx scripts/migrate-to-supabase.ts
scripts.db:backup: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && prisma generate && tsx scripts/backup-cloud.ts
scripts.test:unit: tsx scripts/test-humanizer.ts && tsx scripts/test-fact-guard.ts && tsx scripts/test-security.ts
